description: EMP-ZK arithmetic proof system with two critical bugs exploited for information leakage.

bugs.name: Broken Batched Multiplication Check
bugs.details: uni_hash_coeff_gen(chi, seed, 1) should be uni_hash_coeff_gen(chi, seed, task_n). With 1, only chi[0] is derived. Loop bounds 'for(uint32_t i = start + task_n - 1; i < start + task_n; ++i)' makes loop execute exactly once, checking only the last multiplication gate per batch.

bugs.name: Delta Can Be Forced To Zero
bugs.details: Nothing prevents verifier from choosing delta = 0. With delta=0, MAC relation mac = key + delta*value becomes mac = key, converting quadratic check to linear relation.

attack_steps: Patch verifier (client) to force delta = 0 in delta_gen()
Add logging to record ka, kb, kc, seed, V from the one-gate check
Each connection leaks equation: kb*g(X) + ka*(last + X) = V/seed + kc (mod p)
Where g(X) = prod_{i=0..8}(vec2[i] + X) = c0 + c1*X + ... + c8*X^8 + X^9
Rearrange to linear system in 10 unknowns (c0..c8, last)
Solve 10x10 system over GF(2^61-1) using Gaussian elimination
Factor polynomial g(X) over GF(p) to find roots
Roots are -vec2[i] for i=0..8, negate to get vec2 elements
Submit multiset as guess for vec1 (works because vec1 is permutation of vec2)

math_details.polynomial_form: g(X) = prod_{i=0..8}(vec2[i] + X) = monic degree-9 poly
